extDescription.message: Detects videos (MP4, WebM, HLS, DASH) and downloads them fast over many connections into one MP4 – with subtitles and resuming.

hintStream.message: This video is played from a stream – click the extension icon to choose the quality.

hintRefresh.message: Reload the page with the video and download it again.

errEncrypted.message: This stream is encrypted (DRM / AES key). The extension does not download such content.

errAccessDenied.message: Access denied (HTTP $1) – the link may have expired or requires signing in.

errGone.message: The file is no longer at this address (HTTP $1) – the link expired or the video was removed.

errTooManyRequests.message: The server limits the number of requests (HTTP 429) – lower the number of connections in the settings and try again.

errServer.message: Server error (HTTP $1) – try again in a moment.

errNotMedia.message: The server returned a web page instead of the video – the link has probably expired or requires signing in.

errDropped.message: Connection dropped before the end of the file

errRangesStopped.message: The server stopped supporting range requests

errDroppedChunk.message: Connection dropped in the middle of a chunk

errAssemble.message: Error assembling the file from chunks

errSizeMismatch.message: The size of the assembled file does not match

errDashLive.message: Live streams in DASH format are not supported.

errNoTracksInManifest.message: The manifest contains no tracks to download

errDashNoDuration.message: The manifest doesn't give the length of the video, so the list of segments can't be worked out.

errNotHls.message: This is not an HLS playlist (.m3u8)

errNotDash.message: This is not a DASH manifest (.mpd)

errAudioNotAac.message: Audio track in a format other than AAC

errVideoCodec.message: Video codec $1 – merging into MP4 is not supported

errAudioCodec.message: Audio codec $1 – merging into MP4 is not supported

errCodecChange.message: Codec changes in the middle of the stream

errWebm.message: WebM format – merging into MP4 is not supported

templateHelp.message: {title} – page title, {quality} – e.g. 720p, {file} – name from the address, {site} – domain, {date} – today's date

toastHanded.message: Handed over to the browser downloads

fileNameTitle.message: File name (without extension) – you can change it before downloading

subtitlesTitle.message: Subtitles (saved next to the video as .srt)

downloadTitle.message: Download over many connections at once

plainDownloadTitle.message: Regular browser download (1 connection, without the page headers)

recordTitle.message: Records the live stream until you stop it in the download manager

playlistUnreadable.message: couldn't read the playlist – will try anyway

manifestUnreadable.message: couldn't read the manifest – will try anyway

protectedStream.message: Protected stream (DRM / encryption) – cannot be downloaded.

dashLiveUnsupported.message: Live streams in DASH format are not supported (HLS ones are).

emptySubpage.message: No videos detected on this sub-page yet.

emptyTab.message: No videos detected on this tab yet.

emptyHint.message: Start playing the video – the extension will pick it up from the network traffic.

emptyReload.message: If the page was open before the extension was installed, reload it.

managerUnfinished.message: $1 unfinished downloads – open the manager to resume them

clearTitle.message: Clear the list of detected videos for this tab

settingConnectionsTitle.message: How many parallel HTTP connections per file (MP4/WebM). For HTTP/1.1 servers Chromium-based browsers open at most 6 connections per host.

settingSegmentsTitle.message: How many HLS/DASH segments to download at the same time

settingParallelTitle.message: How many videos to download at the same time (live recordings don't count towards the limit)

settingMp4Title.message: Video, audio and HLS/DASH segments are put together into one .mp4 file – no re-encoding, no quality loss

settingNotifyTitle.message: Notification when a download finishes or fails while this tab is in the background

diskNote.message: Downloaded data goes straight to disk. If you close this tab or restart the browser, downloads resume when you open the manager again.

addPlaceholder.message: Paste a link to a video file (.mp4, .webm…), an .m3u8 playlist or an .mpd manifest

infoLive.message: live stream – downloading the part available now

infoNoRanges.message: the server doesn't support ranges – 1 connection

showTitle.message: Show the file in its folder

fileGone.message: The file is no longer on disk

downloadAgainTitle.message: Add the same download once more

historyRemoveTitle.message: Remove from history (the file stays on disk)

hintSeparateFiles.message: Video and audio are in separate files. Merge them without quality loss:

hintTsFile.message: Play the .ts file in VLC / MPC-HC. Converting to .mp4 (no quality loss, a few seconds):

keptHint.message: $1 – "Resume" will continue the download from here

interruptedHint.message: The recorded part is on disk – you can save it or keep recording.

confirmRemove.message: Remove this download together with the downloaded data?

emptyJobs.message: No downloads. Click the extension icon on a page with a video and choose "⚡ Download".
